description: This file defines MainActivity for an Android TV app. It extends FragmentActivity and hosts the HomeFragment, setting up the main screen layout with a FrameLayout container. It also handles key events for TV remote controls, such as navigation and selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity is the primary activity for the Android TV app's home screen, responsible for setting up the layout and hosting the HomeFragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates the container FrameLayout, sets it as the content view, and loads the HomeFragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events such as DPAD, ENTER, and BACK for remote control navigation and interactions.
